_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: Requires a Meta app in Live mode; Development mode only reaches app admins.
Exchange the short-lived user token for a long-lived one, then derive a
Page token from it - Page tokens derived this way do not expire.
pages_manage_posts requires App Review unless you are a Page admin.

schedule.notes: Native scheduling - between 10 minutes and 6 months out. A recurring workflow can queue posts here and skip the browser entirely.

rate_limits.note: Meta throttles rather than bans. A 429 means back off, not that the account is at risk - the opposite of the browser path.

why_prefer_this: Sanctioned: no ToS exposure and no account-restriction risk.
Stable: survives site redesigns that break DOM-driven posting.
Native scheduling: no machine needs to be awake at post time.
Structured errors instead of guessing from a page that may have silently discarded the post.

notes: Authored before the source field existed; endpoints corroborated from Meta documentation rather than fetched from Meta.
